upgrade.preservation: Canonical SHA-256 before/after: artwork bytes, jobs, paid attempts, original message IDs, captions, source snapshots, delivery payloads, views, daily selections, subscriptions and progress match.
intentional_changes_excluded_from_digest: delivery status, retry/error bookkeeping and updated_at for recognised interrupted edits

integration_scenarios: One shared generation updates three week-old original cards across two chats, for both verses and chapters.
Disabled provider still records original targets; later ready images can fulfil them.
Chat settings changes preserve passive edits; full source is validated immediately before editing.
More than ten transport failures and process restart keep retrying the same target.
Deleted or blocked target does not block other users; inactive waiters do not starve active users.
Later successful same-source version fulfils a request tied to an earlier failed image.
Migration revives previously recorded expired/configuration-cancelled original targets.
limitations: New paid generation and live multi-user fanout were not exercised: all ten daily API attempts were already used.
PostgreSQL integration uses controlled provider and Telegram adapters; live Rich Message editing was separately confirmed in 1.7.0.
Historic messages without a recorded acknowledged original ID cannot be recovered safely.
Persistent waiting does not guarantee successful generation: per-job generation limits, uncertain-outcome policy and budget remain in force.
Deleted or permanently noneditable targets become unavailable; blocked chats wait for restored access.
No restore of the new schema-010 dump was performed; the last full cloud restore test is recorded in 1.7.0.
Rich Messages require a compatible Telegram client.
